outcome: Association between PFD and body image disturbance (BID)
cohort: Pregnant women attending for pregnancy care at University Hospitals Leuven
finding: Pelvic floor dysfunction was highly prevalent during pregnancy and postpartum, with constipation and urinary incontinence being the most common symptoms, and the severity of PFD symptoms was associated with body image disturbance.
mod_finding: The study controlled for mode of delivery when assessing the association between pelvic floor dysfunction and body image disturbance in pregnant women.
